verdict: Yes, for a team with fertility specialists. Subhag from Jhumri Telaiya pitched an IUI treatment technology for infertility on Shark Tank India Season 2 and got a deal. Infertility treatment is expensive and scarce outside big cities, and affordable options have a large market.
angle: Many couples in smaller cities can't reach or afford IVF clinics. Simpler treatments such as IUI, offered through local gynaecologists, fill that gap. The ART Act regulates fertility clinics, so compliance is essential.
